title: Estimating Between-Person and Within-Person Subscore Reliability with Profile Analysis
method_and_assumptions: Partitions subscore reliability into between-/within-person components under its model
establishes: A framework for profile reliability exists
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Does not validate CHAVI cross-fitted transformations or long-interval stability
protocol_implication: Do not claim decomposition is novel; simulation needed before adoption

title: Profile Reliability of Cognitive Ability Subscores in a Referred Sample
method_and_assumptions: Applies profile reliability to cognitive subscores
establishes: Profile interpretation needs evidence beyond global score stability
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Different instruments, cohort, scaling, and design

title: Long-Term Stability of IQ Scores for Children With Neurodevelopmental Disabilities: Stable Global IQ But Unstable Index, Subtest, and Profile IQ Scores
method_and_assumptions: Long-term stability; profileR between-/within-person analysis; mixed-model ICCs
establishes: Shows a recent related longitudinal clinical application
does_not_establish_for_chavi: SB-5 normed scores and 650 clinical cases do not establish CHAVI results
protocol_implication: Motivates but cannot predict CHAVI level/shape ordering

title: Added Value of Subscores: Can We Accurately Evaluate It?
method_and_assumptions: Studies accuracy of methods assessing subscore added value
establishes: Added-value assessment is an existing problem
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Abstract insufficient to transfer its methods; CHAVI prediction utility untested
protocol_implication: No claim that five profiles add value over level

title: A Guideline of Selecting and Reporting Intraclass Correlation Coefficients for Reliability Research
establishes: ICC labels are ambiguous without formula
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Guideline thresholds are not biological truths
protocol_implication: Report ICC(A,1)/ICC(C,1) formulas; heed erratum DOI 10.1016/j.jcm.2017.10.001

title: Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods
method_and_assumptions: ADEMP and Monte Carlo error reporting
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Does not supply CHAVI DGM or validate intervals
protocol_implication: Use ADEMP and prespecified performance measures

title: A longitudinal data resource to study brain development and transdiagnostic variation in executive function
method_and_assumptions: Describes Penn LEAD: 132 adolescents and multimodal/cognitive longitudinal data
does_not_establish_for_chavi: Does not validate this five-task profile construct or exact timing assumptions
protocol_implication: Use as dataset source, not psychometric validation
